messages:
kevin: opened PR with new autoscale examples covering 'burst' and 'sustained' policies. link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2410
maya: saw the examples, nice separation. can we include a short matrix showing cost tradeoffs (tokens/sec vs cost/hr)?
kevin: added a tiny table under examples/README.md — rough numbers only.
lin: heads up: the ruby SDK snippet in examples/ruby/dedicated.rb uses old `scale_policy: :auto` symbol; ruby SDK now expects `scale_mode: 'autoscale'`. i'll push a fix to the snippet extraction branch
sam: thanks. also we should explain scale-down cooldown default (300s) in the autoscale docs — folks assume immediate scale-down and get surprised
kevin: good catch. i'll add a sentence: "scale-down cooldown defaults to 300s to avoid oscillation; tune with `cooldown_seconds`."
ci-bot: docs build queued for PR #2410 — check: snippets linter, linkcheck
ci-bot: snippets linter failed: examples/ruby/dedicated.rb: line 8 - unknown key `scale_policy`
lin: that matches my local failure. patch incoming.
lin: snippet patch: ```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Dedicated.new
client.create_capacity(name: 'team-ruby', tier: 'reserved', scale_mode: 'autoscale', isolation_labels: {team: 'payments'})
``` replaced symbol and added isolation_labels example
maya: can we also add a short note about isolation_label cardinality? i.e., prefer 1-2 labels, not entire config maps. customers have used `env: *` which breaks shard packing
sam: agree. i'll write a one-liner best-practice: "Prefer narrow labels (team, env) to avoid fragmenting pools."
kevin: another linkfix: external onboarding doc references /docs/dedicated/provisioning#eviction-policy — we standardized on 'preemption-policy' anchor. i'll add a redirect and update the external link owner in the ticket tracker
maya: added redirect entry in _redirects.md and updated the external link TODO in the ticket. pinged partner-eng to update their wiki
docs-bot: preview for PR #2410 available: https://deploy-preview-2410--docs.redwood.com
ci-bot: snippets linter passed after patch. linkcheck shows one broken anchor in migrations/old-schema.md
lin: that broken anchor was from a renamed header. i'll push a fix to migrations/old-schema.md with the new anchor and leave a note in the commit message
kevin: can someone add a tiny migration hint for customers moving from policy `eviction` -> `preemption`? just a CLI rename example would help
maya: added migrations/snippets/rename-eviction-to-preemption.md with CLI and SDK examples for python/ruby.
sam: quick review: wording ok, but suggest changing "noisy neighbors" phrasing to "resource contention" for docs tone
maya: changed wording accordingly.
kevin: LGTM. once CI is green, feel free to merge.
ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #2410
lin: merging now. merging in 2 minutes to give search index a chance to pick up redirects
maya: thanks for the quick turn. will follow up to add the cost matrix to the handbook later this week
_meta: created_by: kevin; context: docs coordination — autoscale examples, ruby SDK snippet fix, cooldown note, migration snippet for eviction->preemption, redirect and link fixes
